1003-5006-8170-8250.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Phyrexian Walker is starting in your graveyard.
1003-5006-8170-8250.description:

Resolve the Phyrexian Walker spell. Then, activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat.

1981-2415-6634-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
1981-2415-6634-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.

Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

792-1385-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
792-1385-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat, Totentanz and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Totentanz ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

Activate Extruder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Sigil Captain triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

1594-2034-4871-7147-7817.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Paradox Shaper // Omit Variables by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Helm of Awakening.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-3921-6822.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Winding Constrictor
Repeat.

413-1116-1263-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Sek'Kuar and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodsoaked Champion enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

1978-7329-7685.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is 2 or greater.
1978-7329-7685.description:
Animate Arc Reactor using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate Arc Reactor by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Arc Reactor.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-5088-5148-7443-7537.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three basic lands.
2438-5088-5148-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
2438-5088-5148-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Early Harvest by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Early Harvest.
Resolve a copy of Early Harvest, untapping basic lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Early Harvest, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Early Harvest with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Early Harvest from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Early Harvest by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Early Harvest.
Resolve a copy of Early Harvest, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Early Harvest, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Early Harvest.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 18.

3678-6696-6871-6879.description:

When Horn of Ramos enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Horn of Ramos.
Activate Horn of Ramos by sacrificing it.
Haru triggers, returning Horn of Ramos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

328-5220-5231-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.
328-5220-5231-6900.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

643-3073-3951-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve a Altaïr trigger, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the other Altaïr trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

1170-2397-2733-5954-6664.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {G}.

Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

428-1694-3090-3604.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
You have enough mana to cast Harmless Offering.
428-1694-3090-3604.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying its mana cost, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Cast Ghyrson Starn by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Ghyrson Starn enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Ghyrson Starn with haste.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn's trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 6.

751-1741-5542.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Cloud of Faeries by paying {1}{U}.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Holding priority, activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Resolve the second Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning it and Cloud of Faeries from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Universal Automaton, adding {1}.
When Universal Automaton dies, Zask triggers.
Holding priority, cast Universal Automaton from your graveyard by paying {1}.
Resolve the Zask trigger, causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat from step 2.

957-2493-2665.description:

At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer.
When the token Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

682-2060-4499-4929.description:

When Supply Runners enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

2544-3371-5149.notablePrerequisites:
Codie does not have summoning sickness.
Power Artifact attached to Filigree Sages.
Any nonpermanent spell in hand with mana to cast it.
2544-3371-5149.description:
Activate Codie by paying {4} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {U}, untapping Codie.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, cast any nonpermanent spell by paying its mana cost.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.

719-1909.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {G}.

Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Ezzaroot Channeler.

Cleric Class is at least level two.
You have a way to gain life.
104-2999-4186.description:

The Squirrel enters the battlefield, triggering Impassioned Orator, causing you to gain two life.

2026-3525-3573.notablePrerequisites:
Voyaging Satyr does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Voyaging Satyr.
You control at least two artifacts.
2026-3525-3573.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Voyaging Satyr by tapping it, untapping Tolarian Academy.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Voyaging Satyr.
